title: Tariffs Hurt Williams-Sonoma More Than the Housing Market
summary: Williams-Sonoma  stock dropped on Wednesday even though the home specialty retailer delivered a beat-and-raise quarter in tough times for housing. While other retailers are logging tariff refunds, Williams-Sonoma is feeling a sting.
